messages.subject: Re: order by month for seasonality
parts:
The old-school R approach is to define the factor with levels = month.abb or month.name.
Base R has built-in "constants" (really objects with pre-defined values: you _could_ give them different values, but don't! for months, letters, and pi (?month.name).

So, something like 
seasonalfactors$month_abb <- factor(seasonalfactors$month_abb , levels = month.abb, ordered = TRUE)
There is a way to reorder on the fly in ggplot2, but I recommend against it, especially in cases like this where you'll want the variable as an ordered factor for everything you do with it.  Tidying your dataframe first is a good rule no matter which R idiom you use.

Tom
